note: Jobs the AI characters can offer (M12). giver: whose job it is, one card id or a list (Oda's when absent; issue #188: the smuggling run and the contract are Oda's, the fence's, Skrugs's and T-89's). Only real jobs: each one completes when something actually happens in the game (completes_on is a WorldState trigger). requires uses the same conditions as rumors. requires.story = the story chapter reached (Story.reached).

jobs.title: Droids for the general
jobs.text: Bring me assassin droids from the desert, fixed up or bought. I pay three times what the droid merchant does, a head. Hand them over to me at the barracks.
jobs.note: Issues #203, #204: the general's repeating job (giver: only his brain offers it). Not while Remnant standing is hostile (-40 and below, where his troopers shoot on sight). Each droid handed over pays and raises standing, and the job is open again (GeneralPost.hand_over). 'words': what he says when he offers this job; an offer whose line talks about another job's words is put right (NpcBrain), so the card always matches what he said.

jobs.title: Supplies for the locals
jobs.text: The locals holding %s are running out of water and charge packs. Take them a load before the Remnant come back for it; they pay %d credits.
jobs.note: Issue #187: on the board while an outpost the locals hold is short (Territory.supply_target). Taking it is carrying the supplies; walking up to that outpost hands them over, pays and fills the locals' hold back up (Territory.deliver). Taken once, the card leaves the board for good: from then on the F11 map shows which outposts are short, and any of them takes supplies when you get there (Territory.supplier).

jobs.objective: Take your ship up to the orbital patrol
jobs.title: Thin the orbital patrol
jobs.text: The locals pool 1000 credits for anyone who breaks the Remnant patrol in orbit. Your ship is in the pit; the pad is the button.

jobs.objective: Hand cargo droids to a droid merchant
jobs.title: Cargo droids for Oda's friend
jobs.text: Oda's friend, a droid merchant, needs three cargo droids. Buy them or fix some up in the desert, then hand them over at any droid merchant's post out there: the arrow points to the nearest.
jobs.note: Issue #212: the droid merchant chapter's job card, so it is queued and in the job log. Delivering the third droid (Story.on_droid_delivered) finishes it, taken or not.

jobs.title: The range bet
jobs.text: Knock all five practice targets flat in under twenty seconds. The pot is 40 credits and some pride.

jobs.title: A drop for the fence
jobs.text: Somebody left %s %s. Get it to the fence in the market, and keep it away from the Remnant at the front gate.

goods.say_one: a crate of space whale teeth

jobs.note: Repeats forever: Oda lines up the next drop once the last one is picked up and the player carries no contraband. Pays is what the fence gives for the goods; the fence pays it, not Oda. Issue #64: opens with the story's first smuggling run (Story chapter smuggle_1). Issue #251: 'areas': only the drops out of town (the desert past either gate); the ones inside the town are the general's (j_general_repossess).

jobs.title: Repossess the contraband
jobs.text: Smugglers have stashed %s %s. Repossess that contraband and bring it to me at the barracks. I pay better than any fence, and the garrison will put it to better use.

goods.say_one: a crate of space whale teeth

jobs.note: Issue #251: the general's repeating smuggling job (giver: only his brain offers it, in talk, with offer_job). The same goods as the fence's run, but only from the stashes inside the town ('areas': the alleys and the roofs), and in his words: repossessing contraband for the garrison. 'deliver_to': the goods go to him, not the fence: his [E] menu takes the contraband off you for 'pay_mult' times what the fence would pay (WorldState.hand_over_contraband) and raises Remnant standing. One drop is out at a time, his or Oda's. Never moves the story on. Not while Remnant standing is hostile.

jobs.title: A drop for the station merchant
jobs.text: Somebody left %s %s on the rock outside. Get it to the merchant in front of the cantina.

goods.say_one: a crate of space whale teeth

jobs.note: Repeats forever on the asteroid: the drop lands on the rock outside the sealed station, and the merchant in front of the cantina buys it. No story requirement; it belongs to grit_station_town only.

jobs.title: A job on a Remnant control room
jobs.text: The Remnant keep a stash of refined quantonium in the control room at %s. Take %s and a droid, hack the console, and bring the flasks to the fence. About %d cr after the crew's cut.
jobs.note: Issue #310: the locals' heist (src/systems/flow/heist.gd). Offered by the four who offer the drop and the bounty, on an outpost the Remnant hold (never while the locals hold them all). Taking it sends a local crew member and a white assassin droid with you; the console's stash (15 flasks, content/core/story/heist.json) goes to the fence, less the crew's cut. One heist at a time, either side's; a new one once the last is paid, for ever. The text is filled in: the outpost, the crew member, the pay. Issue #413 moves 'requires.story' to the heist chapter.

jobs.title: Take back what the locals stole
jobs.text: The locals squat in our outpost at %s, and our stores of refined quantonium sit in its control room. Take %s and a droid, hack the console, and bring the flasks to me. I pay better than the fence: about %d cr after your trooper's share.
jobs.note: Issue #310: the Remnant's heist, free roam only, offered by the general in talk (offer_job). It hits an outpost the locals hold (Territory), so it is not offered while they hold none, nor while Remnant standing is hostile (-40 and below), nor in a story save. A Remnant trooper and a Remnant assassin droid go with you; the general takes the flasks for 'pay_mult' times the fence's price (WorldState.hand_over_contraband's rate), less the crew's cut, and Remnant standing goes up.

jobs.title: A price on a Remnant officer
jobs.note: Issue #64: repeats forever once the story reaches the bounty. The text is filled in from WorldState.bounty (the officer's name, their crime, the outpost, the pay); taking it puts the officer at that outpost; the fence pays when they are dead. Pays is the bounty.
